portfolio.bodyCompleted: The Ninja NFT is the parent identity. Every approved bounty mints a child NFT beneath it, turning completed work into a portable builder portfolio.
portfolio.bodyEmpty: The Ninja NFT is already minted as the parent identity. The first approved bounty will add a child NFT to this public collection.
portfolio.bodyEmptyPending: The Ninja NFT parent identity is being minted. Once it lands, the first approved bounty will add a child NFT to this public collection.
portfolio.bodyEmptyNotMinted: The Ninja NFT parent identity is not minted yet. It is issued after onboarding, and approved bounties then add child NFTs to this public collection.
portfolio.emptyBodyCompleted: Approved work appears here after payout and minting begins.
portfolio.emptyBodyNew: Complete an active bounty and the first child NFT will appear here as on-chain proof.
